subject.title: [Feature]: Mattermost — Parity improvements (formatting, reactions, rich interactions)

question: Should Mattermost read receipts and user presence become a plugin-supported OpenClaw capability, be explicitly descoped, or be split into a narrower canonical issue before implementation?
rationale: Current main lacks the capability, but exposing read receipts or presence affects privacy, event semantics, and likely config/default behavior, so automation should not choose that product contract.

options.title: Split And Define The Contract
options.body: Create or retitle a focused Mattermost presence/read-receipt issue with expected events, privacy/default behavior, docs, and validation before implementation.

options.title: Document as descoped
options.body: Update the Mattermost docs or this issue to state that read receipts and presence are intentionally unsupported for now.

options.title: Implement under the umbrella
options.body: Proceed in the Mattermost plugin only if maintainers accept the event/config/privacy semantics in this broader issue.

recommendation.title: Split And Define The Contract
recommendation.body: Create or retitle a focused Mattermost presence/read-receipt issue with expected events, privacy/default behavior, docs, and validation before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter already reviewed this umbrella for the same remaining product-scope gap and has recent Mattermost plugin/docs history.
